 Pay Fixation for Retired Personnel
 Candidates who have superannuated from State Agricultural Universities (SAUs) or
equivalent institutions and are not entitled to pension shall, upon appointment, have
their pay fixed in accordance with the prevailing rules, regulations and pay scales
prescribed by Birsa Agricultural University. In the absence of any existing rules in this
regard, the pay fixation shall be governed by such rules, regulations or guidelines as may
be prescribed by the University from time to time, with the approval of the competent
authority. Such candidates shall be required to abide by the applicable pay fixation rules,
regulations and conditions prescribed by the University.
 Re-opening of Application Timeline
 The application process for the post of Deputy Director (Training) is hereby re-opened up to
dated 12.11.2026. Fresh candidates fulfilling the amended eligibility criteria may submit their
complete applications in the prescribed proforma, along with biodata, duly signed in all
respects, addressed to the “Assistant Director Administration (Recruitment), Birsa
Agricultural University, Kanke, Ranchi – 834006”, through Registered Post/Speed Post, so
as to reach the University on or before dated 12.11.2026 up to 05:00 PM. Applications
received after the prescribed date and time shall not be accepted under any circumstances.
 Instructions for Previous/Existing Applicants
 Candidates who have already submitted their applications against Advertisement No.
BAU(VC) 19/2026 dated 15.09.2026 need not apply afresh. Their applications shall
remain valid, subject to verification of eligibility under the revised criteria.
 Such candidates may submit additional supporting documents or updated information
relevant to the revised eligibility criteria by emailing scanned copies to the Recruitment
Cell at recruitmentbau50@gmail.com within the above-mentioned period.
 General Terms and Conditions
 All other terms and conditions of the original advertisement shall remain unchanged,
except as specifically modified by this Corrigendum.
 No application or additional document shall be accepted after the prescribed deadline,
subject to applicable recruitment rules.
 Any further updates in this regard shall be notified on the official website of Birsa
Agricultural University: (www.bauranchi.org).
By Order of the Vice-Chancellor
Sd/-
